messages:
novum-support: NovumAI reporting increased 5xxs and timeouts on hosted endpoints since ~14:10Z. Customer sees intermittent 502/504s, p95 generation latency spikes to 6s. Ticket 38421.

maria_oncall: ack, I'm on it. Can you paste a minimal repro and affected model/route? Also number of concurrent reqs?

novum-support: repro: curl loop 50 rps to /v1/generate with token X-REDACTED. Model redwood-13b-std. Inputs are short (avg 80 tokens). They observed gateway 504s when queue_depth > 120. Happened after enabling edge fanout to EU region.

ajay_infra: seeing a correlated surge in request_queue_depth on gateway-prod-eu-02 around 14:09Z. queue_depth peaked 380, dequeue rate stalled. p50 dequeue latency -> 20ms, p99 -> 1.2s then timeouts. Likely continuous-batcher backlog + fanout hitting thin pools.

sloane_support: Novum says they did no sudden traffic increase (steady 50 rps), but enabled fanout to reduce latency; seems to have backfired.

rebecca_runtime: digging into batcher logs. Found repeated "batcher/backpressure: cannot accept more requests, depth_limit_exceeded" and a flurry of KV cache misses during cold spinup. Snippet:

```
WARN batcher/backpressure depth_limit_exceeded tenant=novum-tenant depth=324 limit=256
ERROR kvcache: miss spike during spinup tenant=novum-tenant keys=1.2k -> evictions
```

maria_oncall: action: temporarily disable edge fanout for tenant to stop cross-pod amplification. Can someone flip routing policy for novum-tenant EU to single-region routing?

ajay_infra: flipping policy now -> `rbacctl set-route novum-tenant --region eu-west-1 --fanout=false`. Pushing change.

ops-bot: deploy:route-change succeeded for novum-tenant at 14:28Z by ajay_infra

novum-support: changed. initial metrics look better but tail latency still elevated. p95 dropped from 6s -> 3.8s.

rebecca_runtime: recommend two mitigations: 1) lower continuous-batcher max_batch_window from 30ms -> 12ms for this tenant, 2) raise queue depth limit for dedicated thinpools temporarily from 256 -> 384 to allow drain. Both are low-risk and reversible.

maria_oncall: agree. Rebecca can you apply batcher config for tenant? Ajay, can infra bump thinpool quota for gateway-prod-eu-02?

rebecca_runtime: applied `max_batch_window=12ms` to novum-tenant at 14:33Z. Monitoring.

ajay_infra: increased thinpool depth limit to 384 on gateway-prod-eu-02 at 14:35Z. Watch metrics.

sloane_support: customer reports 504s dropping. New sample: p95 ~2s, error rate down 93%.

rebecca_runtime: still seeing some KV hotspots; adding short-term sticky routing to warm caches: set `kv_warm=true` for novum-tenant for 10m.

ops-bot: config:update succeeded (kv_warm) at 14:39Z

maria_oncall: summary so far: root cause = fanout + continuous-batcher backlog + cold KV spinup causing queue depth runaway and early rejects/timeouts. Fixes applied: disabled fanout for tenant, reduced batch_window, increased thinpool depth, enabled kv warm. Error rate dropped significantly.

novum-support: NovumAI confirms production is stable and will keep an eye overnight. Thanks.

maria_oncall: follow-ups: 1) run a replay load test with fanout enabled against a staging cluster to repro the thinpool amplification, 2) consider safer defaults: lower max_batch_window for fanout-enabled tenants + auto-kv-warm on fanout toggle, 3) run post-incident blameless writeup.

rebecca_runtime: created runbook ticket RBR-729 to add auto-mitigations. I'll attach traces and a brief timeline.

maria_oncall: closing thread in 1h if stable. Great triage team work :thumbsup:
